lessons.title: Solid Color
lessons.conceptIntro: The simplest shader: every pixel returns the same uniform color. Introduces the half4/uniform basics.
learningNotes: main(fragCoord) runs once for every pixel in the preview.
half4 stores red, green, blue, and alpha as the shader's output color.
baseColor is a uniform, so Compose can change it without recompiling AGSL.

lessons.title: Animated Color
lessons.conceptIntro: Drive the output color from a time uniform written every frame via withFrameNanos. The uniform `time` is a float in seconds.
learningNotes: time is written every frame, so the same shader code produces changing pixels.
sin(time * speed) oscillates between -1 and 1; the math remaps it to 0..1.
mix(a, b, t) blends two colors, with t choosing how far to move from a to b.

lessons.title: Linear Gradient
lessons.conceptIntro: Normalize fragCoord, project it onto a direction vector, then mix two color uniforms along that axis.
learningNotes: fragCoord is the current pixel position in device pixels.
startColor and endColor are uniforms, so the gradient palette can change live.
angle rotates the direction vector; dot(centered, direction) becomes the blend amount.

lessons.title: Radial Gradient
lessons.conceptIntro: length(uv - 0.5) gives distance from screen center. Aspect-correct by multiplying x by width/height.
learningNotes: Subtracting 0.5 recenters UV space so the origin is in the middle.
Multiplying x by width/height keeps the circle round on non-square previews.
radius controls how quickly distance fades from the inner color to the outer color.

lessons.title: Polar Coordinates
lessons.conceptIntro: atan(p.y, p.x) gives the angle from origin; combine with length() for swirling polar effects.
learningNotes: length(uv) gives radius: how far the pixel is from center.
atan(uv.y, uv.x) gives angle: which direction the pixel points.
Subtracting time * speed shifts the phase, making the swirl rotate.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep the speed slider 0 → 4 for a hypnotic swirl.

lessons.title: Animated Vignette
lessons.conceptIntro: smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x) gives a soft 0→1 transition. Pair with length() for an antialiased vignette.
learningNotes: length(uv) turns centered coordinates into distance from the middle.
radius moves the first smoothstep edge, changing the size of the lit area.
softness controls the gap between smoothstep edges, widening or sharpening the fade.

lessons.title: Diagonal Stripes
lessons.conceptIntro: Repeat one coordinate with fract(), then threshold it with step(). The skew uniform shears the stripe field.
learningNotes: fract(value * count) creates a fresh 0..1 ramp for every stripe repeat.
step(0.5, ramp) turns that ramp into a crisp two-color mask.
Adding uv.y * skew tilts the pattern without rotating the whole canvas.

lessons.title: Polka Dots
lessons.conceptIntro: Tile UV space with fract(uv * cells), recenter each tile, then draw one circle SDF per cell.
learningNotes: fract(uv * cells) gives local coordinates inside every repeated tile.
Subtracting 0.5 moves each tile origin to its center.
length(g) - radius is the same circle SDF, reused across the full grid.

lessons.title: Hex Grid
lessons.conceptIntro: Compare two offset rectangular lattices and keep the closer center to build a hex-spaced repeat.
learningNotes: The second lattice is shifted by half a cell so rows interleave.
Picking the shorter vector gives each pixel a nearest-center coordinate.
smoothstep around the cell radius turns distance into a clean grid edge.

lessons.title: Truchet Tiles
lessons.conceptIntro: Hash each cell to choose an orientation, then draw quarter-circle SDFs that connect across tile borders.
learningNotes: floor(uv) names the current tile, so the hash stays stable inside it.
Mirroring f.x flips the tile while keeping the same local coordinate range.
The min of two arc distances produces the paired curves in every tile.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep cells 6 → 18 for a satisfying density bloom.

lessons.title: Moire Interference
lessons.conceptIntro: Overlay two nearly aligned stripe waves. Tiny angular differences create large beat patterns.
learningNotes: Each stripe field is just sin(dot(uv, direction) * density).
Taking abs(stripeA - stripeB) reveals where the two waves disagree.
Contrast narrows the smoothstep band, making the interference sharper.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep angle 2 -> 24 to show broad bands collapsing into tight ripples.

lessons.title: Kaleidoscope Fold
lessons.conceptIntro: Fold polar angle into repeated wedges, then shade the folded space as one mirrored slice.
learningNotes: atan() converts the pixel into polar angle, which can be repeated like any coordinate.
mod(angle, wedge) repeats the slice; abs() mirrors it around the slice center.
Twist adds radius back into angle so the symmetry bends outward from the center.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep twist -4 -> 6 while holding segments near 8 for a mirrored bloom.

lessons.title: Plaid Weave
lessons.conceptIntro: Cross two repeated stripe masks. Alternating cell parity sells the over-under weave.
learningNotes: The vertical and horizontal thread masks use the same centered cell coordinate.
floor() gives stable tile indices that can flip color from cell to cell.
Adding masks creates plaid, while clamp() keeps the blend in display range.

lessons.title: Herringbone Tiles
lessons.conceptIntro: Alternate mirrored tile coordinates so diagonal stripes meet as a herringbone zig-zag.
learningNotes: mod(tile.x + tile.y, 2) splits the grid into alternating orientations.
Mirroring one coordinate flips the diagonal grain without new geometry.
A second edge mask draws grout lines over the procedural wood stripes.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep scale 4 -> 14 to make the tile rhythm tighten.

lessons.title: Radial Burst
lessons.conceptIntro: Repeat angular space instead of UV space. Each repeated sector becomes one ray.
learningNotes: atan() gives angle; dividing by tau maps it into a repeatable 0..1 coordinate.
fract(angle * rays) creates the same wedge ramp around the full circle.
Adding radius * twist bends the rays while keeping them anchored at center.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep rays 8 -> 48 for a poster-like burst reveal.

lessons.title: Brick Bond
lessons.conceptIntro: Hash each cell before fract() so the wall allocates stable random brick chunks.
learningNotes: Scaling x and y differently makes rectangular cells instead of square tiles.
Each cell hash decides whether the base brick stays whole or splits into smaller chunks.
Distance to the nearest cell edge becomes a mortar mask.

lessons.title: IQ Cosine Palette
lessons.conceptIntro: a + b·cos(2π·(c·t + d)) maps a 1D parameter to a smooth color ramp. Six floats define the entire palette.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep phase 0 → 1 — ramp glides through the whole spectrum.

lessons.title: HSV Wheel
lessons.conceptIntro: Polar coords give hue (angle) and saturation (radius). hsv2rgb without branches is a four-line piecewise.

lessons.title: Gradient Stops
lessons.conceptIntro: Branch on the parameter for two-segment gradients. Reshape with pow(t, k) to bias toward dark or light.

lessons.title: ACES Tone Map
lessons.conceptIntro: HDR colors above 1 must be tone-mapped before display. ACES gives a filmic shoulder/toe in 8 ALU ops.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep exposure 0.2 → 3 — sun saturates without ever clipping pure white.

lessons.title: Circle SDF
lessons.conceptIntro: A signed distance field is a function returning distance to a shape's edge. length(p) - r is the canonical circle.

lessons.title: Rounded Box
lessons.conceptIntro: Box SDF with corner radius: subtract `r` from the distance to round the edges.

lessons.title: Smooth Metaballs
lessons.conceptIntro: opSmoothUnion(d1,d2,k) blends two SDFs with a smoothness factor — yielding the classic goo/metaball look.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Try smoothness 0.05 → 0.5 for a goo merge effect.

lessons.title: Checkerboard
lessons.conceptIntro: floor() + mod() turn continuous space into discrete cells — the simplest periodic pattern.

lessons.title: Breathing Grid
lessons.conceptIntro: Tile space with fract(uv * n), then place an animated SDF in each cell.

lessons.title: Isolines
lessons.conceptIntro: fract(distance * n) produces concentric rings — a contour-line visualization.

lessons.title: Pseudo-Random Hash
lessons.conceptIntro: fract(sin(dot(p, magic)) * big) yields cheap, deterministic per-pixel noise — the bedrock of procedural texturing.

lessons.title: Value Noise
lessons.conceptIntro: Bilinear-interpolated hash gives smooth-ish noise — the ancestor of Perlin/Simplex.

lessons.title: fBM Clouds
lessons.conceptIntro: Sum N octaves of noise, doubling frequency and halving amplitude each step. Bounded loop required for AGSL.

lessons.title: Voronoi Cells
lessons.conceptIntro: For each pixel, find the nearest jittered seed in a 3×3 neighborhood. Animate seeds with sin(time) for cellular life.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Record 30s with cells=12 — looks alive, very LinkedIn-friendly.

lessons.title: Plasma
lessons.conceptIntro: Three sine sums + an HSV-like phase shift = 90s demoscene plasma in 8 lines.

lessons.title: Warped Lava
lessons.conceptIntro: Domain warping: feed fbm into itself. The payoff lesson — looks like a graphics textbook cover.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Record 45s of warped-lava as the showcase prelude.

lessons.title: Easing Curves
lessons.conceptIntro: Easings reshape a 0→1 parameter over time. Compare linear, cubic-out, cubic-in-out, and back-out side by side.

lessons.title: Sine Harmonics
lessons.conceptIntro: Adding 1/k·sin(k·x) terms approximates a square wave. The Gibbs ringing is visible at the discontinuities.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep harmonic 1 → 12 — wave sharpens visibly with each step.

lessons.title: Wave Train
lessons.conceptIntro: Stack N sine rows offset in phase — each row reads the same wave at a slightly later moment.

lessons.title: Pendulum Chain
lessons.conceptIntro: N oscillators with detuned frequencies fall in and out of phase — a hypnotic 'pendulum wave'.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Record 30s — eye sees an apparent travelling wave despite each dot moving 1D.

lessons.title: Mandelbrot
lessons.conceptIntro: Iterate z ← z² + c until |z| escapes. Smooth iteration count + cosine palette gives continuous coloring.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep zoom 0.5 → 8 — boundary becomes increasingly intricate.

lessons.title: Julia Set
lessons.conceptIntro: Same iterate as Mandelbrot, but c is fixed across the plane. Animate c to morph the set in real time.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Record 45s — set continuously morphs, irresistible to watch.

lessons.title: Newton's Method (z³ − 1)
lessons.conceptIntro: Newton iteration on z³−1 has 3 attractors. Color each pixel by the root it lands in — basins are fractal.

lessons.title: Sierpinski Gasket
lessons.conceptIntro: Iterated function systems: zoom into the corner copy that contains the pixel, repeat, then evaluate one triangle SDF — exact geometric self-similarity.

lessons.title: Lambert Sphere
lessons.conceptIntro: Lambert: diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0). The whole 'looks 3D' illusion in one inner product.

lessons.title: Phong Highlight
lessons.conceptIntro: Add specular = pow(max(dot(R, V), 0), n). Shininess collapses the highlight from gloss to mirror.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Sweep shininess 4 → 96 — highlight tightens like adjusting a real flashlight.

lessons.title: Rim Light
lessons.conceptIntro: rim = pow(1 - dot(N, V), p) — sells silhouette and rescues unlit darks. Free 'subsurface' look.

lessons.title: Day/Night Terminator
lessons.conceptIntro: Same Lambert dot product, but blend between *two* shaded materials. Softness widens the dawn band.

lessons.title: Spotlight
lessons.conceptIntro: touchPos lands as a uniform in 0..1 UV space. Distance + smoothstep gives a soft pool of light at the cursor.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Tap-and-drag is shown as discrete taps — each tap re-anchors the spotlight.

lessons.title: Tap Ripple
lessons.conceptIntro: (time - touchTime) drives a Gaussian band whose radius grows. Re-tap restarts the wave.

lessons.title: Pull Field
lessons.conceptIntro: Distort sample coords toward the cursor with exp falloff — texture bends like a gravity well.

lessons.title: Heat Shockwave
lessons.conceptIntro: Combine distance-to-touch with (time - touchTime) inside a sin() — phases sweep outward like a thermal pulse.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Tap repeatedly — overlapping shockwaves create rich beat patterns.

lessons.title: Box Blur
lessons.conceptIntro: Average 9 samples around each pixel — the simplest convolution kernel. Increase radius for stronger blur.

lessons.title: Chromatic Aberration
lessons.conceptIntro: Sample R/G/B at offset coordinates → cheap analog-camera fringe.

lessons.title: Ripple
lessons.conceptIntro: Offset sample coords along radial direction by sin(dist - time) for a continuously-rippling pond.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Bump strength to 25 for the most dramatic recording.

lessons.title: Dissolve
lessons.conceptIntro: Use fbm noise as an animated alpha mask with a glowing edge — Thanos snap on a Composable.

lessons.title: Liquid Glass Displacement
lessons.conceptIntro: Sample the input at a noise-displaced coord — produces the iOS 26-style refractive panel feel.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: 0.6 strength makes the displacement pop without losing legibility.

lessons.title: Pixelate
lessons.conceptIntro: Snap fragCoord to a grid → mosaic. Increase cell size for chunky retro pixels.

lessons.title: Ripple on Tap
lessons.conceptIntro: Multi-touch + drag emit into a 16-slot ripple ring buffer that distorts a live Compose surface (gradient + bokeh + typography). Anisotropic specular streaks along crests, chromatic refraction (R bends more than B), Schlick fresnel sky-tint, foam fringe at peaks.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Drag with two fingers for streak interference. Record portrait — the prism + foam reads instantly.

lessons.title: Codex Splash
lessons.conceptIntro: A procedural Codex-style splash screen: layered AGSL atmosphere, SDF icon tile, cloud glyph, terminal marks, prismatic logo glass, and an interactive water RenderEffect over the composed scene.
lessons.screenRecordingHint: Tap or drag across the splash for strong water ripples over the glass logo.
